notes: Single Pump unit model built directly in build-and-solve.py (not a library flowsheet).

Mapped properties are the four Pump1-in inlet states plus Pump1-Work (the pump's mechanical power, an observable property on Pump1 itself). Pump1-Work is named 'Work' but is mechanical power in Watts (fs.pump.work_mechanical[0]). The TTL still declares no s223 properties on Pump1-out, so the outlet state stays under unmapped_watertap_variables.
Property paths are written relative to 'fs' (i.e. m.fs), matching the seawater-ro mapping convention.

unmapped_watertap_variables.fs.pump.control_volume.properties_out[0]: pump outlet pressure [Pa] - no s223 property on Pump1-out yet
unmapped_watertap_variables.fs.pump.deltaP[0]: pump pressure rise (fixed 500000 Pa) - design input
